class.name: NNDistanceVector3Sensor
class.brief_description: Distance sensor. Uses the squared distance when scaling the values to 0..1 range.
class.description: Computes the vector [member from_to_vector] ([code]from_vector - to_vector[/code]) and [member distance_squared] on evaluation, setting [member NNSensors.sensor_value] to [code]distance_squared / (max_distance * max_distance)[/code]. Optionally computes the non-squared [member distance] and normalised [member direction_vector].

members.member: The normalised [member from_to_vector]. Requires [member is_direction_vector_calculated] to be [code]true[/code]. A zero vector when [member from_vector] and [member to_vector] are equal.
Optionally calculated non-squared distance. Updated during evaluation when either [member is_distance_calculated] or [member is_direction_vector_calculated] is [code]true[/code].
Squared distance between [member from_vector] and [member to_vector]. Updated on every evaluation.
Displacement vector calculated as [code]from_vector - to_vector[/code]. Updated on every evaluation.
The start point of the distance calculation.
If [code]true[/code], calculates [member direction_vector] (and [member distance]) on evaluation.
If [code]true[/code], calculates the non-squared [member distance] on evaluation.

The distance that maps to a [member NNSensors.sensor_value] of [code]1.0[/code]. The sensor value is [member distance_squared] divided by squared [member max_distance] (not clamped, so distances beyond this score above [code]1.0[/code]). Must be non-zero.
The end point of the distance calculation.
